blockingFindings.evidence: Physical wrapper uses generic system2/deploy/remote_d1_rest_adapter.mjs. That adapter allows arbitrary SQL via prepare().run(), batch(), and rawQuery(). The workflow detects rowsWritten after execution but does not reject mutating SQL before Cloudflare transport.
blockingFindings.risk: A future reachable module could mutate isolated D1 before the post-run rowsWritten check fails.
blockingFindings.requiredRepair: Wrap the generic adapter inside the physical runner with a runner-local read-only guard that rejects mutating SQL before transport. Reuse the repository-proven SELECT/WITH/PRAGMA allow + INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/REPLACE/CREATE/DROP/ALTER/VACUUM/ATTACH/DETACH deny pattern from .github/workflows/d02-pve244-d1-readonly.yml.

blockingFindings.evidence: sameCutRuntimeEvidence currently returns instrumented=true and runtimeForbiddenAccessCount=0 as literals.
blockingFindings.risk: The static architecture is isolated, but the runtime evidence cannot independently distinguish actual guarded no-access from an asserted zero.
blockingFindings.requiredRepair: Produce a same-cut runtime capability/access ledger. Derive runtimeForbiddenAccessCount from measured/guarded counters rather than a literal. Bind ledger identity and counters into typedEvidence -> runtimeEvidenceDigest -> auditDigest -> HIDDEN_FALLBACK_AUDIT_SHA256 -> final receiptHash.

minimumRuntimeLedger.derivation: runtimeForbiddenAccessCount must be computed from forbidden/mutation/capability violation counters. instrumented=true only when guards are actually active.

networkGuardRule.requirement: Wrap physical runner fetchImpl and reject any origin outside the frozen source/Cloudflare contract before network access.
networkGuardRule.reason: Static import audit cannot by itself prove a runtime module did not fetch an unexpected external/System1 endpoint.
